It enables Leveraged LP by staking LST, RWA, or Uni V2 LP, pairing a strong Asian presence with a hyper‑variety LP offering and support for single‑sided LP. With 1000x leverage trading, Aark delivers scalable liquidity with minimal slippage and costs, paving the way for its 1000x leverage feature and a more efficient, high‑capability trading experience.
